scope: Exposed-label development proposal; not a blind validation or production default
rule: w_i = sigma_i^2 / sum sigma_j^2; participation = 1 / sum w_i^2; rank = floor(participation + 0.5)
reason: Use the effective number of transition pairs rather than admitting arbitrarily weak configurations to reach a cumulative norm cutoff
offdiagonal: Unscaled bare projected Slater-Condon, unchanged from the 95 percent trial
reuse: Identical existing single-CSF functional for rank one; already converged same-rank parent checkpoints otherwise
limitation: Choice of participation-based rank was proposed after examining the 95 percent trial; fresh independent validation and rank-boundary sensitivity remain required
